mapper.select: select id, title, slug, summary, cover_url, tags, author_id, author_name, content_html, content_markdown, content_json, status, visibility, is_paid, seo_title, seo_description, seo_keywords, canonical_url, published_at, wechat_media_id, wechat_account_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, del_flag from content_article where slug = #{slug} and del_flag = '0' limit 1

select id, title, slug, summary, cover_url, tags, author_id, author_name, null as content_html, null as content_markdown, null as content_json, status, visibility, is_paid, seo_title, seo_description, seo_keywords, canonical_url, published_at, wechat_media_id, wechat_account_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, del_flag from content_article where del_flag = '0' and status = 'PUBLISHED' and visibility = 'PUBLIC'
and title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
and slug = #{slug}
order by published_at desc, id desc

select id, title, slug, summary, cover_url, tags, author_id, author_name, content_html, content_markdown, content_json, status, visibility, is_paid, seo_title, seo_description, seo_keywords, canonical_url, published_at, wechat_media_id, wechat_account_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, del_flag from content_article where slug = #{slug} and status = 'PUBLISHED' and visibility = 'PUBLIC' and del_flag = '0' limit 1

select distinct a.id, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.tags, a.author_id, a.author_name, null as content_html, null as content_markdown, null as content_json, a.status, a.visibility, a.is_paid, a.seo_title, a.seo_description, a.seo_keywords, a.canonical_url, a.published_at, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, a.del_flag from content_article a inner join content_publish_job j on j.article_id = a.id and j.target_code = 'SITE_WENDAO' and j.status = 'SUCCESS' and j.del_flag = '0' inner join content_publish_result r on r.job_id = j.id and r.target_code = 'SITE_WENDAO' and r.site_url is not null and r.site_url != '' and r.del_flag = '0' where a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = 'PUBLISHED' and a.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
and a.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
and a.slug = #{slug}
and a.tags like concat('%', #{tags}, '%')
order by a.published_at desc, a.id desc

select a.id, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.tags, a.author_id, a.author_name, a.content_html, a.content_markdown, a.content_json, a.status, a.visibility, a.is_paid, a.seo_title, a.seo_description, a.seo_keywords, a.canonical_url, a.published_at, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, a.del_flag from content_article a inner join content_publish_job j on j.article_id = a.id and j.target_code = 'SITE_WENDAO' and j.status = 'SUCCESS' and j.del_flag = '0' inner join content_publish_result r on r.job_id = j.id and r.target_code = 'SITE_WENDAO' and r.site_url is not null and r.site_url != '' and r.del_flag = '0' where a.slug = #{slug} and a.status = 'PUBLISHED' and a.visibility = 'PUBLIC' and a.del_flag = '0' order by j.finished_at desc, j.id desc limit 1

select trim(substring_index(substring_index(a.tags, ',', n.n), ',', -1)) as tag_name, count(*) as article_count from content_article a inner join content_publish_job j on j.article_id = a.id and j.target_code = 'SITE_WENDAO' and j.status = 'SUCCESS' and j.del_flag = '0' inner join content_publish_result r on r.job_id = j.id and r.target_code = 'SITE_WENDAO' and r.site_url is not null and r.site_url != '' and r.del_flag = '0' cross join ( select 1 n union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5 union select 6 union select 7 union select 8 union select 9 union select 10 ) n where a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = 'PUBLISHED' and a.visibility = 'PUBLIC' and char_length(a.tags) - char_length(replace(a.tags, ',', '')) >= n.n - 1 and trim(a.tags) != '' group by tag_name order by article_count desc, tag_name asc

select a.id, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.tags, a.author_id, a.author_name, null as content_html, null as content_markdown, null as content_json, a.status, a.visibility, a.is_paid, a.seo_title, a.seo_description, a.seo_keywords, a.canonical_url, a.published_at, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, a.del_flag from content_article a inner join content_publish_job j on j.article_id = a.id and j.target_code = 'SITE_WENDAO' and j.status = 'SUCCESS' and j.del_flag = '0' inner join content_publish_result r on r.job_id = j.id and r.target_code = 'SITE_WENDAO' and r.site_url is not null and r.site_url != '' and r.del_flag = '0' where a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = 'PUBLISHED' and a.visibility = 'PUBLIC' order by a.published_at desc, a.id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update content_article set del_flag = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id = #{id}
